MOTIONS
Amended Petition

MOVING
PARTY
Plaintiff Joaquin Del Cid
OPPOSING PARTY
None
MOTION
Plaintiff Joaquin Del Cid (“Plaintiff”) petitions
the Court to confirm the arbitration award in his favor regarding Plaintiff’s individual
wage and hour claims.
Plaintiff served
this amended petition on Defendant Jonathan Club (“Defendant”) on February 13,
2026 by mail, electronically, and personally.
(See Proof of Service, filed February 13, 2026.)
The personal service is sufficient notice, as
it was effectuated 16 court days before the hearing of this motion.
(Code Civ. Proc., §§ 1290.4, subd. (c), 1005,
subd. (b).)
Defendant has not objected
to the notice given and has not filed an opposition to the motion to confirm
Plaintiff’s arbitration award.
Accordingly,
the Court confirms the arbitration award, which is attached as Exhibit A to the
Declaration of Edward W. Choi in Support of Plaintiff’s Petition to Confirm Arbitration
Award. Pursuant to Code of Civil Procedure section 1287.4, Defendant is ordered
to pay Plaintiff within 30 days of the issuance of the judgment confirming the arbitration
award in this matter.
The stay of
Plaintiff’s representative PAGA claims is lifted.
Plaintiff is to
give notice of the Court’s ruling and to file proof of service of same.
